paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: when Jesus shows up, nobody gets to stay neutral. The Magi saw His star and came to worship Him (Matthew 2:2). Herod heard that a King had been born and he was disturbed (Matthew 2:3). Same King, two totally different hearts.

Look at Herod, because he's sneaky about it. He says, "so that I too may go and worship Him" (Matthew 2:8). Friend, you can SAY the right words and still have a heart that's pointed the other way. I think the Magi's way is the better road: they fall down, they worship, and they open their treasures (Matthew 2:11).

So what do you do with that today? You bring Jesus your best, and you bring it with joy, like the Magi who "rejoiced with great delight" (Matthew 2:10). They did it for a Child in a house, and they got a warning in a dream and listened to it (Matthew 2:12). Worship Him with your whole heart, baker, and when God says go another way, take the other way.
